calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/hidx_score_qw_1018/signoff_ffrepair.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/hidx_score_qw_1018/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/hidx_score_qw_1018 --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_hbm_idx_score_qw_static  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: OWN-IDXSCORE 2026-10-18: W glue column of the wires-only IDX quarter scorer (landed-regions standard: the 1.12 x 2.25 mm quarter is dissolved into the die, not hardened with one tree). Input pin flops + W glue (key line split, valid/keep lanes, meta input, W fault cause) + registered output stage (+1 edge on every leaf input) + reset relay. Height = the two leaf rows (2 x 561.6); E face feeds leaf (0,0) and (1,0) W faces. TW3-IDXSCORE 10-19: E face re-pinned to the leaf W pins: two row sections (row 0 bottom, row 1 top), each in the leaf W order qv,q,kv,kkv,key,aux,bus with per-port pin_ranges from the shared leaf face table; query/valid/zero-bus and the reset relay replicated per row (no pin drives both rows). cycles_added 1 = the registered output stage (+1 edge on every leaf input). TW4-IDXSCORE 10-19: r2 trial GRT overflow 147,829 (M3, y 394-566 um) = the 4,396-bit key_lines W port centred on the face and feeding both rows' E key sections (~2.2k bits crossing the row boundary vertically in an 86 um column). Fix: key_lines split per row (key_lines0 = chunks 0,1, key_lines1 = chunks 2,3) and every W port pin_ranged level with its E consumer (query beside o_q0, key halves beside o_key0/o_key1, control in the row-0 zero-bus window); clk_ctl moved to the W face at the row boundary (centre of the register mass; r2 TT pin-flop spread 82.2 ps from the N-face entry). No logic or cycle change.
